name: Unique Menu Icons (Gen 2 MEWMON)
description: Gives every Gen 1 Pokemon its own unique party/menu icon instead of the vanilla shared body-type icons (QUADRUPED, BIRD, SNAKE, etc). Only the MEWMON palette (menu icon column, Mew/Mewtwo/Jynx) is recolored to the authentic Gen 2 red scheme, in both SGB and Advanced display modes; all other species keep their normal colors. Toggle via the GBC PALLETE ON/OFF option (also affects the title screen and Oak's intro, which share the MEWMON slot). Icon art: MiniDex sprites by Chamber, Solo0993, Blue Emerald, Lake, Neslug and Pikachu25.
